Title: Skye Technology ResourceSpace DAM Connector
Description: Bring Your Own DAM to Umbraco 17+: browse, search, preview, and deliver ResourceSpace assets directly to Razor views and the Headless Content Delivery API without duplicating files into the Umbraco Media Library.

AuthorDetails.Name: Skye Technology
AuthorDetails.Description: Senior digital engineering and multi-CMS architecture consultancy specialising in modern .NET and Umbraco platforms.

Screenshots.Caption: Selected ResourceSpace DAM assets in the Umbraco 17 Bellissima backoffice with live DAM status badges and editorial alt-text overrides.
Slide-out ResourceSpace Asset Picker modal with keyword search, resource-type filters, and rendition/metadata inspector.
Automatic backoffice governance warning when an asset is restricted or archived in ResourceSpace.
Responsive DAM renditions streamed live to Razor views via the <dam-image /> TagHelper without media duplication.
